scenicChapters.title: Atlantic Highway, A39
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 54 km this is Atlantic Highway, A39, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

atlantic-highway-a39.story: From Barnstaple it runs 237 km to Newquay; allow about 3 h 11 of riding. On the way it passes Bude, Tintagel and Padstow. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
